jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Deployment Project Manager to join our team.

Position Description

The Deployment Project Manager is a pivotal, execution-focused role responsible for advancing Oklo’s mission to deliver clean, affordable, and reliable energy. This individual owns the end-to-end delivery of one or more highly complex powerhouse projects, from design integration and site development through construction, startup, commissioning, and turnover to operations.

These multi-year, non-recurring projects include significant first-of-a-kind scope, substantial commercial value, evolving risks, and complex dependencies across internal teams, external partners, regulators, and other key stakeholders. The Deployment Project Manager serves as the central point of coordination, driving integrated planning, decision-making, risk management, and clear communication among project teams, executive leadership, and external parties. Success in this role requires a strategic and hands-on leader with a startup mindset - someone who can bring structure to ambiguity, operate effectively in a resource-constrained environment, and maintain momentum, accountability, and alignment throughout the full project lifecycle.

Location: Remote, with 25%–40% travel required

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Lead end-to-end execution of powerhouse facility deployments from design through startup and turnover to operations.
  • Support and maintain integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, and execution tools to monitor progress and drive delivery.
  • Identify, manage, and escalate risks, issues, dependencies, and changes to protect critical path, licensing, regulatory, and commercial objectives.
  • Lead project governance routines, including status reviews, stage-gate reviews, and executive reporting.
  • Manage project scope, risks, issues, and dependencies while proactively identifying and implementing mitigation strategies.
  • Communicate project status, recommendations, and strategic insights to stakeholders ranging from project teams to executive leadership.
  • Support permitting, licensing, facility modifications, equipment installations, and infrastructure upgrade projects.
  • Oversee contractor performance, procurement activities, material sourcing, and project deliverables.
  • Serve as the primary point of coordination among internal teams, customers, contractors, vendors, and other external stakeholders.
  • Contribute to technical strategy, execution planning, and continuous improvement initiatives that support organizational goals.
  • Ensure projects are executed safely, efficiently, and in compliance with applicable quality, regulatory, and operational requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Nuclear Engineering, Business, or a related technical discipline.
  • Minimum of 5 years of project management experience leading complex technical, engineering, construction, manufacturing, or operational projects.
  • Experience managing project scope, schedules, budgets, risks, milestones, and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams, resolve blockers, and communicate effectively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to operate with agility and sound judgment in a fast-moving, evolving organization.
  • Proficiency with project planning, scheduling, and collaboration tools.

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Nuclear experience in design, construction, commissioning, or operations
  • PMP certification is strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing contractor-driven projects, capital projects, facility upgrades, or equipment installation efforts.
  • Familiarity with quality assurance, configuration management, permitting, or regulatory compliance processes.

Competencies

We are looking for a Deployment Project Manager that is:

  • Passionate about advancing the deployment of next-generation powerhouse facilities
  • Creative when pursuing tasks in resource constrained environments
  • You’re not afraid to roll up your sleeves and deliver
  • You see how the pieces connect and can manage interfaces
  • You turn ambiguity into momentum
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • An active and effective communicator of priorities
  • Able to recognize, accept, and manage risk
  • Passionate about Oklo's mission to design and deploy advanced fission power plants to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $100,000-$160,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

Na frente de Serviços Digitais para a Prática Médica, buscamos transformar a experiência dos profissionais de saúde por meio de produtos digitais escaláveis, seguros e confiáveis.

O iClinic é uma das soluções digitais da Afya voltadas para a prática médica, apoiando médicos e clínicas na gestão e organização de suas atividades.

♿Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas a pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitadas do INSS.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa Especialista em Arquitetura de Software para atuar de forma transversal na frente de Serviços Digitais para a Prática Médica, com foco no ecossistema iClinic.

Essa pessoa terá um papel estratégico na evolução da arquitetura dos produtos, apoiando decisões técnicas desde o discovery até o go-live e garantindo que as soluções sejam construídas considerando escalabilidade, segurança, resiliência, performance e eficiência.

Além do olhar para o iClinic, o papel possui uma visão cross, contribuindo para a integração e evolução do ecossistema tecnológico da Afya e promovendo padrões e boas práticas entre diferentes times e produtos.

Um dos principais desafios da posição será fortalecer a perspectiva de segurança dentro das decisões arquiteturais, atuando de forma próxima aos times de Engenharia, Segurança da Informação, Infraestrutura, Produto e Dados:

  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de software dos produtos, incorporando Security by Design desde a concepção das soluções;
  • Tomar e orientar decisões arquiteturais considerando trade-offs entre segurança, escalabilidade, performance, resiliência, custo e velocidade de entrega;
  • Apoiar a definição de stacks, frameworks, ferramentas e padrões técnicos utilizados pelos times;
  • Atuar em parceria com Engenharia, Produto, Dados, Segurança e Infraestrutura desde o discovery até o go-live;
  • Definir e disseminar padrões de arquitetura, desenvolvimento seguro, documentação técnica, versionamento, deploy e gestão de segredos;
  • Realizar revisões técnicas e arquiteturais, análises de impacto e apoiar a evolução técnica dos times por meio de mentorias;
  • Atuar na identificação e redução de dívidas técnicas, vulnerabilidades e riscos arquiteturais;
  • Apoiar a implementação de práticas de DevSecOps nos pipelines de CI/CD, incluindo controles e análises automatizadas de segurança;
  • Orientar decisões relacionadas a cloud, observabilidade, resiliência, eficiência de custos e segurança em ambientes AWS;
  • Apoiar projetos de modernização, integração e evolução dos sistemas, considerando APIs, mensageria, arquitetura orientada a serviços e interoperabilidade;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com Segurança da Informação e Infraestrutura para fortalecer a proteção das aplicações e a conformidade dos ambientes;
  • Ser uma referência técnica para os times, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e contribuindo para a evolução da maturidade arquitetural da organização.

🔎 O QUE BUSCAMOS (mas não esperamos que uma única pessoa atenda a todos os requisitos):

  • Experiência sólida atuando como Arquiteto(a) de Software em produtos digitais de média ou grande escala;
  • Experiência prática e sólida com AWS — requisito obrigatório;
  • Experiência com cloud, Kubernetes e ambientes de infraestrutura;
  • Conhecimento de arquitetura de software e padrões como microserviços, arquitetura orientada a eventos e Domain-Driven Design (DDD);
  • Experiência com segurança aplicada à arquitetura de software, incluindo conceitos de Security by Design;
  • Conhecimento de IAM, OAuth/OIDC, SSO, gestão de segredos e fundamentos de criptografia;
  • Experiência com APIs, integrações, mensageria e sistemas distribuídos;
  • Conhecimento de CI/CD, DevSecOps e práticas de segurança no ciclo de desenvolvimento;
  • Experiência com infraestrutura como código, como Terraform ou CloudFormation;
  • Capacidade de analisar cenários, tomar decisões arquiteturais e documentar claramente os trade-offs e decisões técnicas;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de influenciar tecnicamente diferentes stakeholders;
  • Perfil autônomo, colaborativo, proativo e com capacidade de atuar como referência técnica.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência no segmento de Health Tech;
  • Vivência com produtos voltados para saúde ou prática médica;
  • Experiência com proteção de dados sensíveis, especialmente dados relacionados à saúde;
  • Conhecimento de LGPD, ISO 27001, NIST CSF ou outros frameworks de segurança e conformidade;
  • Experiência com IA e aplicações de Inteligência Artificial;
  • Conhecimento de referências como AWS Well-Architected Framework e AWS Security Reference Architecture (SRA).

Buscamos uma pessoa que vá além de conhecer tecnologias: alguém capaz de tomar decisões arquiteturais, avaliar cenários, entender impactos e fazer escolhas conscientes entre curto e longo prazo.

Será importante conseguir explicar decisões técnicas relevantes da sua trajetória, os problemas que precisava resolver, quais alternativas avaliou, quais trade-offs assumiu e quais foram os resultados dessas escolhas.

A posição terá bastante autonomia e espaço para influência técnica, atuando de forma próxima aos times e olhando para a evolução do iClinic e do ecossistema de tecnologia da Afya.

jobs.title: JobRack - Recruitment Partner
jobs.excerpt: For recruiters who want ownership, variety, impact and a great team.
jobs.description:
For recruiters who want ownership, variety, impact and a great team.

$3000-$3500 | Full-time | CET timezone

Hey, I'm Noel, CEO and Owner at JobRack, and I'm on a mission to build the most amazing recruitment business with the most amazing team.

Here's a short video by way of introduction.

There's a lot of detail below. If you don't like details, that's completely fine. It just means this role isn't for you.

About us

JobRack helps small businesses and start-ups in the US and Europe hire remote team members from Eastern Europe and South Africa.

We're a fully-remote team of 8 just now. What sets us apart is that we actually know each other, support each other, and share one goal: helping our clients hire amazing candidates.

Clients work with us for three reasons:

☑️ We find them people they couldn't find themselves

☑️We give them a lot of help and support to hire successfully

☑️We're confident enough in our service to offer a one-year guarantee

We recruit across ecommerce and DTC marketing, creative and paid social, SEO and content, customer support, operations and project management, professional services, legal, executive assistance, finance, sales and tech.

You can hear from our clients at

Here’s some of the comments we get from candidates:

I had a great experience with Jobrack. They helped me get a great job, and Chelsea was very helpful and professional from start to finish. The overall process was quite smooth.

I had a phenomenal experience with JobRack! Thank you for helping me get my dream job.

They were very thoughtful, communicative, provided regular feedback throughout the process. I felt supported all the way.

Our core values:

  • We have clarity - we know where we're going and what's expected of us
  • We work with focused speed
  • We are positive and professional
  • We wow our clients
  • We constantly improve
  • Above all, we are helpful and friendly.

Our culture is fun, rewarding, high-achieving and focused on getting things done. We're a small team doing great work and having a good laugh along the way!

Why this role exists?

Here's the honest version.

Our clients are business owners. They're busy, they're often hiring for something they've never hired for before, and they're trusting us with a decision that really matters to them.

What they need isn't someone who takes the brief and disappears. They need someone who sits with them, asks the questions they hadn't thought of, tells them when something won't work, and genuinely gets excited about the person they end up hiring.

That's what a Recruitment Partner does. Partner is the important word.

You're not taking orders and you're not just filling a vacancy. You're their equal in the conversation, and we have clients who come back again and again because of how it felt to work with us.

You'll work on all kinds of roles.

We hire a lot in ecommerce, DTC marketing, creative, SEO, content, customer support, ops and project management, executive assistants, and finance too.

But you'll also work on roles involving software engineers, developers, data or product.

Good solid tech roles, and we want someone who genuinely enjoys them rather than tolerates them.

You'll join a small recruitment team and report to Chelsea, our Recruitment Lead.

You’ll get short feedback loops, quick decisions, and a lot of trust.

You'll also be working alongside our Sourcing Specialist, who does the heavy lifting on finding candidates.

You'll still get stuck into sourcing when a role needs it, and you'll need to be good at it, but you won't be spending your days in a boolean search.

Your time goes to clients, candidates and getting hires across the line.

What you'll do

🤝 Look after your clients really well. Run the onboarding call, understand their business, and stay close to them through the whole process. They should finish every call feeling clearer and more confident than when they started.

🔍 Find brilliant people. Work with our Sourcing Specialist to build shortlists that make a client's decision easy.

💻 Take on the briefs. You'll work across a mix of technical and non-technical roles, and we expect you to know your stuff before you dive in.

Thoroughly research the client, the role, the market and what good looks like so you're properly prepared before speaking to candidates or going back to the client.

🎙️ Interview like you mean it. Get past the CV to what actually makes someone right for this business, this founder, this team.

🔄 Keep candidates in the loop. Scheduling, tasks, feedback, the lot. Nobody should ever be left wondering where they stand with us.

💬 Say the hard thing kindly. If a salary won't buy what a client wants, tell them. If a spec is unrealistic, say so early. Clients thank us for this.

🎯 Own your roles. Drive the strategy, watch the numbers, and take real pride in the result.

Requirements

What you need to excel

✅ 5+ years as a recruiter in an agency environment, working internationally

✅ Experience with clients in the USA, UK and Europe, with founders and business owners as your direct hiring managers

✅ Genuine sourcing ability including using AI to support you. Boolean, LinkedIn, weird and wonderful places to find great candidates, the lot. You won't live in sourcing here, but you need to know it

✅ Experience with ATS systems (we use Workable just now)

✅ Sourcing experience in South Africa and/or Eastern Europe is a strong advantage

On the tech side. Our tech hiring doesn't look like corporate recruiting.

You don't need to have been a pure tech recruiter and we're not asking for big-tech experience.

What you do need is enough depth to read a technical CV properly, hold your own in a conversation with a developer without a hiring manager in the room, and tell a client when their spec and their budget don't line up.

AI. We love AI but we love the human touch more. You’ll know how to use AI to make you incredibly efficient enabling you to spend your time on the real human touches that make the difference.

All of our clients need people who can work with AI really well, we call it AI-fluent hiring, and we expect the same of our own team.

You should already be using it in your own work and be able to judge it credibly in a candidate.

Who thrives here

The people who thrive at JobRack are the ones who take real ownership and also sweat the details. Fast, but definitely not sloppy. Warm, but straight with people.

That looks like:

🤝 A natural partner. You build proper relationships with clients and candidates. You're comfortable being their equal, challenging them when it's needed and being challenged back.

💪 Thorough. You dig into profiles and compare them properly. You never send a CV you couldn't defend.

🏁 Driven. You set your own pace. You're happy owning a number and being measured on it - for us that's candidate quality, candidate quantity and speed of hire.

🔧 Always improving. You spot what's broken and fix it rather than just flagging it.

🚀 Make-it-happen. Nobody should need to chase you.

😊 Helpful and friendly. This one's non-negotiable. It's how we treat clients, candidates and each other.

If you'd rather be handed clearly defined tasks, work at a gentler pace, or be closely supervised, you won't enjoy working here.

Working hours

Monday to Friday, 8 AM – 5 PM CET, with some flexibility for early evening calls with US clients from time to time.

Benefits

What's in it for you

💰 Monthly salary of $3,000–$3,500*

🌍 Full time and fully remote

⏱️ Core hours 8am–5pm CET with some flexibility

🏝️ 20 days paid holiday and 5 days paid sick leave per year

✈️ Team retreats

🌱 Real scope to grow as JobRack grows

*This is a gross figure and you're responsible for any tax procedures in your country of residence. Please apply only if you're happy to work remotely as an independent contractor.

As JobRack grows, so will you. In leadership, management and capability. There's significant room on salary growth too. We pay well and reward people through competitive salaries and bonuses.

We talk openly about salary and benefits, because we want people here for the long term.

Hiring process

  1. Complete the application form
  2. Record a short video introduction
  3. If shortlisted, complete test tasks as a sample of your abilities
  4. Interview with one of our team about your experience and the role
  5. In-depth interview with Chelsea and client roleplay with Noel
  6. Referencing and offer

Please take the time to read the job description carefully and submit a high-quality application.

We'll give you feedback throughout the process. Please don't reach out to Noel or Chelsea directly.

This position requires 100% commitment and isn't suitable for anyone seeking a side job, freelance work or part-time employment.

Apply only if you intend this to be your primary and only full-time job.

Attempting to hold multiple full-time jobs without our knowledge may result in termination and a ban from applying to other jobs on JobRack.

jobs.description:
At Tenthpin, we are looking for a highly organised, commercially minded and collaborative Resource & Vendor Management Specialist to join our rapidly growing global team. The successful candidate will play a key role in helping us identify, engage and manage high-quality external consultants across Europe and other international markets, ensuring our clients have access to the specialist expertise required to deliver complex transformation programmes.

Working closely with Partners, Delivery Leads and Resource Management teams, you will help support some of the world's leading Life Sciences organisations, contributing to our reputation as one of the consulting success stories of recent years.

The Opportunity

As a Resource & Vendor Management Specialist, you will play a critical role in supporting the engagement, management and deployment of external consultants across our global business. Acting as a trusted partner to both internal stakeholders and external suppliers, you will help ensure we have access to the right talent at the right time, whilst maintaining strong commercial and operational controls.

The role will include, but not be limited to:

  • Building and managing relationships with subcontracting agencies and staffing partners across Europe and other international markets.
  • Developing and maintaining talent pools of high-quality consultants across key skill areas to support current and future business demand.
  • Partnering closely with Resource Management, Delivery Leads and Partners to understand resource requirements and project priorities.
  • Supporting the end-to-end engagement of external consultants, from requirement through to onboarding and deployment.
  • Negotiating rates and commercial agreements with agencies and subcontracting partners.
  • Ensuring up to date Contractor Master Data
  • Collaborating with Finance, IT, Compliance to further develop/improve the SubCo process
  • Producing reporting and insights relating to vendor performance, consultant utilisation, spend and resource planning activities.
  • Supporting consultant allocations, extensions, replacements and transitions across client programmes.
  • Acting as a key point of contact for consultants, vendors and internal stakeholders throughout the consultant lifecycle.
  • Working as part of a truly global team, collaborating with colleagues across the UK, Europe, USA, Japan and India.
  • Contributing to a business that removes much of the traditional red tape associated with large organisations, allowing you to focus on creating value, building relationships and supporting successful project delivery.

Your Experience

First and foremost, you are highly organised, proactive and relationship-driven, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders simultaneously. You will also bring:

  • Experience within Resource Management, Vendor Management, Contract Recruitment, Workforce Planning or a similar role.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work directly with senior leaders, Delivery Leads and Partners.
  • Experience negotiating rates, contracts and commercial agreements with agencies or subcontractors.
  • Strong reporting and analytical skills, with the ability to provide meaningful insights from data.
  • Excellent Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel.
  • Exceptional organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience working within a consulting, technology or professional services environment would be advantageous.
  • Exposure to SAP, SAP S/4HANA or Life Sciences environments would be beneficial.

Why Tenthpin

Tenthpin is a Global Consulting and Technology Boutique for the Life Sciences industry. With around 450 consultants and constantly growing, we currently operate out of 8 countries: Switzerland, Germany, UK, Portugal, Poland, Japan, USA and India.

At least sixteen of the top 20 Life Sciences companies worldwide trust Tenthpin for independent and unbiased advice.

Our Corporate Services teams are more than a support function. We are subject matter experts and trusted business partners who work closely with colleagues and leaders across the organisation. As part of a truly global and collaborative team, we proactively solve challenges, support growth, and help shape the continued success of Tenthpin.

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package and a collaborative work environment that encourages professional growth and development.

If you enjoy working in an entrepreneurial and international environment, value collaboration, and want to make a genuine impact within a growing global organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

Tenthpin is an equal opportunities employer.

We look forward to hearing from you.

We're hiring a media buyer to own paid acquisition across a pod of 5-8 clients spending a combined $100k+ per day, primarily on Meta. You'll sit inside a cross-functional pod with a strategist, copywriter, and PM and you'll be the person responsible for making sure every dollar in those ad accounts is actually doing something.

You're not uploading creative and toggling budgets when someone tells you to - you're deciding how campaigns get structured, what gets tested and why, when to scale and how aggressively, and whether the data you're looking at is even trustworthy before you optimize against it. You understand funnel math well enough to reverse-engineer what your CPL needs to be to hit a revenue target three steps downstream. You know the difference between scaling 10% because it's safe and pushing 30% because the situation calls for it (and you can defend the decision).

Your strategist sets overall client direction, but you own the ad accounts. That means you're not waiting for instructions on what to do inside the platform: you're actively managing, analyzing, and making judgment calls throughout the day. When something's off you’ve probably already noticed, have a theory, and are working on it.

You'll also be client-facing, but the degree varies by pod; media buyers here interface with clients - whether that's presenting paid performance on calls, answering questions about platform changes, or providing updates on pacing and results. You should be comfortable explaining what you're doing and why in plain language to both client and pod members.

What Success Looks Like

Your strategist isn't checking behind you and they know the accounts are being managed because you're proactively communicating what matters - wins, problems, recommendations - before they have to ask.

The copywriter walks into the creative review call with accurate win/lose data because you updated it 24 hours ago, not 5 minutes before the meeting.

You can explain the 'why' behind every decision in the account: Why this campaign structure, why this budget allocation, why you killed that ad at $X spend and let this one run longer.

You're not telling the team you need more ads after the last batch died and there's nothing left to test. You let them know ahead of time by using our internal forecasting tools, based on win rates, fatigue, and testing cadence, and communicating volume needs before it's urgent.

Scaling decisions factor in the business, not just the ad account. You think about sales team capacity, payment method limits, backend conversion rates - not just 'CPA looks good, let's spend more.'

You're cross-referencing platform data, attribution tools, and internal reporting regularly. If the numbers don't line up, you've flagged it and you're not optimizing off bad data and hoping for the best.

A Day In This Role

You start the morning in the accounts: every account, every day - you’re looking for a quick pulse check before your pod standup. Knowing how the spend pacing, how performance was overnight, any disapprovals or billing issues, any general reporting issues. You're not doing deep optimization yet, just getting the lay of the land so you can walk into standup and tell your team exactly where things stand across the board.

Your communication during stand ups are clear: here's what's pacing well, here's what's not, here's what I'm doing about it. You’re already making adjustments without needing to be told what and how.

Afterwards, you're in the accounts making optimization decisions - killing underperformers that have had their fair shot, adjusting budgets based on your scaling protocols, launching new creative from the tracker into your testing campaigns with proper variable isolation. If you're testing, you know exactly how much spend and volume you need before you make a call on whether something moves to scaling or gets cut.

Throughout the day you're handling whatever comes up - ad disapprovals that need immediate review requests, a billing issue that's causing downtime, a client question the strategist routes your way about why CPAs spiked.

Later in the day you check back in on accounts. Performance can shift, delivery can get weird, something that looked fine at 10am might look different by 3pm. You do not set it and forget it until tomorrow.

Experience & Requirements

  • 2+ years of hands-on media buying experience, managing significant daily spend across multiple accounts simultaneously. Our buyers manage $100k+/day combined on a typical pod.
  • Deep Meta Ads proficiency is critical: you should be able to talk intelligently about campaign architecture, conversion objectives, consolidation strategy, and how platform updates actually affect how you structure and optimize accounts.
  • Google Ads experience is a strong plus, because while most of our accounts are Meta only, sometimes Google/YT ads come into play for certain clients.
  • Experience with third-party attribution and reporting platforms (Hyros, Triple Whale, Segmetrics, Wicked Reports, or similar). We use Hyros - we don't expect you to know it walking in, but you need to be the kind of buyer who's already comfortable working across multiple data sources and can pick up a new attribution tool quickly.
  • Understanding of funnel math and how ad account metrics connect to business outcomes. CPL is not your finish line - you should understand how it flows into show rate, close rate, CAC, ROAS, and why that matters for the decisions you make in-platform.
  • Experience with launch campaigns, not just evergreen. You understand budget phasing, testing windows, event-based ad scheduling, and why launches require a different playbook.
  • Comfortable being client-facing - you don't need to be a relationship manager, but you should be able to present performance data clearly and answer client questions about what's happening in their ad accounts without your strategist translating for you.
  • Strong async communication. We work in slack and clickup, not meetings primarily. You need to communicate clearly in writing - surfacing issues proactively, providing context, and keeping your pod informed without being chased.

You'll Do Well Here If

  • You actually want to understand how the platforms work at a technical level - why the algorithm behaves the way it does and what that means for how you run accounts
  • You think about ad accounts in terms of business impact, not just what's happening inside the platform
  • You surface problems, recommendations, and creative needs before someone has to ask you
  • You're comfortable with direct feedback and high expectations
  • You stay current on platform changes, algorithm updates, and new tools on your own - nobody here is going to brief you on what Meta changed last week
  • You use AI tools where they would be useful (data analysis, research, reporting) and understand where they're not (in-platform judgment, real-time optimization decisions)

This Probably Isn't For You If

  • You're used to managing one or two accounts and want to stay there
  • You optimize based on feel rather than documented protocols and data thresholds
  • You wait for the strategist (or someone else) to tell you what to do in the accounts rather than owning the decisions yourself
  • You're not interested in creative performance - you just run the ads you're given
  • You see ad disapprovals and billing issues as someone else's problem
  • You'd rather hop on a call than write a clear Slack message

BENEFITS:

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans (US Residents Only)
  • PTO
  • Paid US Holidays
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement within the organization.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with a focus on creativity and results.

ADDITIONAL:

  • 9 AM - 6 PM EST
  • Remote
  • W2 (US Residents Only)

OUR CORE VALUES:

  • BE BAD
  • PLAY TO WIN
  • EXTREME OWNERSHIP
  • SOLUTIONS NOT PROBLEMS
  • BEST IDEA WINS
  • ALWAYS BE GROWING
  • NOBODY IS BIGGER THAN THE TEAM

jobs.title: Online Basispsycholoog SGGZ
jobs.excerpt: Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenlandBen jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ?
jobs.description:
Werk volledig remote, ook vanuit het buitenland

Ben jij een ervaren basispsycholoog die zelfstandig kan werken, verantwoordelijkheid durft te nemen en energie krijgt van specialistische GGZ? Heb je al minimaal twee jaar vlieguren gemaakt binnen de SGGZ en wil je jouw expertise inzetten binnen een innovatieve, volledig digitale behandelomgeving?

Dan is Beterggz mogelijk een mooie volgende stap voor jou.

Wij zoeken proactieve basispsychologen die online behandelen serieus nemen. Professionals die digitaal vaardig zijn, stevig in hun rol staan en ook op afstand een sterke behandelrelatie kunnen opbouwen.

Over Beterggz

Beterggz is een online aanbieder van specialistische GGZ. Wij bieden landelijk poliklinische behandelingen aan cliënten met uiteenlopende en complexe zorgvragen.

Ons team bestaat uit psychologen, artsen, psychiaters en andere betrokken professionals. We werken digitaal, multidisciplinair en met korte lijnen. Onze missie is helder: kwalitatief goede GGZ toegankelijker maken, wachtlijsten verkorten en zorg slimmer organiseren.

Omdat wij volledig online werken, maakt het minder uit waar je zit. Of je nu vanuit Nederland werkt of vanuit het buitenland, zolang de kwaliteit, continuïteit en professionaliteit op orde zijn.

Requirements

Wat ga je doen?

Als online basispsycholoog behandel je cliënten binnen de specialistische GGZ. Je voert online behandelgesprekken, doet psychodiagnostiek, stelt samen met collega’s behandelplannen op en bewaakt de voortgang van de behandeling.

Je werkt zelfstandig, maar niet geïsoleerd. Je maakt onderdeel uit van een digitaal multidisciplinair team waarin je afstemt met regiebehandelaren, psychiaters en collega-psychologen. Ook denk je actief mee over de kwaliteit van onze zorg, kennisdeling en de verdere ontwikkeling van digitale behandelprocessen.

De functie vraagt om iemand die overzicht houdt, zorgvuldig rapporteert, risico’s tijdig signaleert en professioneel blijft handelen bij complexe zorgvragen.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken geen starter, maar een zelfstandige basispsycholoog met minimaal twee jaar ervaring binnen de SGGZ. Je hebt een afgeronde master Psychologie, beschikt over een LOGO-verklaring en hebt aantoonbare scholing in Cognitieve Gedragstherapie, CGT.

Je bent gewend om professioneel en gestructureerd te werken, communiceert helder en voelt je prettig in een digitale werkomgeving. Omdat je volledig online werkt, beschik je over eigen apparatuur en een rustige, veilige en professionele thuiswerkplek.

Ervaring of scholing in ACT, EMDR en schematherapie vinden wij waardevol. Dit is geen harde eis, maar wel een duidelijke pre. Datzelfde geldt voor ervaring met persoonlijkheidsproblematiek en andere complexe zorgvragen binnen de SGGZ.

Verder is het belangrijk dat je uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft. Engels kunnen spreken is mooi meegenomen.

Waarom Beterggz?

Bij Beterggz werk je volledig remote, met veel flexibiliteit in waar en wanneer je werkt. Je kunt dus ook vanuit het buitenland werken, zolang je professioneel bereikbaar bent en goede online zorg kunt leveren.

We werken op ZZP-basis met een uurtarief van €70 per uur. Het aantal uren stemmen we samen af en starten kan op korte termijn.

Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende, digitale GGZ-organisatie met korte lijnen, veel vertrouwen en ruimte voor eigen verantwoordelijkheid. Je krijgt de kans om inhoudelijk sterk werk te doen én mee te bouwen aan een moderne manier van GGZ-zorg leveren.

Interesse?

Lijkt het je interessant om als online basispsycholoog bij Beterggz aan de slag te gaan?

Bij voldoende geschikte kandidaten sluiten wij de vacature.

Een VOG-verklaring maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

jobs.description:
REALADVISOR CHEGOU A PORTUGAL
Business Development Representative - Mercado Português | Freelancer / Trabalhador Independente
Ajude-nos a construir e a desenvolver o mercado português

A RealAdvisor é uma das principais plataformas digitais do setor imobiliário na Europa. É uma empresa internacional PropTech, fundada na Suíça, que utiliza dados, transparência e tecnologia para ajudar os profissionais do imobiliário a fazer crescer os seus negócios.
Fundada na Suíça, a empresa trabalha atualmente com mais de 5.000 agências imobiliárias e atrai mais de 10 milhões de utilizadores por ano em vários mercados europeus.
Após o sucesso da RealAdvisor na Suíça, Itália, França, Espanha e Polónia, estamos agora a lançar o mercado português.
Portugal é um mercado totalmente novo para a RealAdvisor. Isto significa que estamos numa fase inicial de desenvolvimento, o que cria oportunidades significativas para profissionais de vendas ambiciosos que queiram entrar desde o início, ajudar a construir o mercado e crescer com a empresa.
Não irá apenas gerir um mercado já estabelecido - terá a oportunidade de ajudar a construí-lo e a moldá-lo de raiz.

A FUNÇÃO

Como Sales / Business Development Representative, será responsável por desenvolver o mercado português e apresentar a solução da RealAdvisor aos profissionais do setor imobiliário.
As suas principais responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Identificar e contactar novos clientes através de prospeção ativa (outbound).
  • Realizar chamadas (cold calls) e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócio.
  • Acompanhar leads e oportunidades inbound geradas pela equipa de SDR.
  • Organizar e conduzir demonstrações de vendas por videoconferência.
  • Apresentar a solução RealAdvisor a agências e profissionais imobiliários.
  • Adaptar a abordagem comercial às necessidades de cada cliente.
  • Negociar e fechar contratos.
  • Gerir todo o pipeline de vendas, da prospeção ao fecho.
  • Identificar as necessidades dos clientes e desenvolver propostas de valor relevantes.
  • Manter previsões de vendas rigorosas e um acompanhamento comercial consistente.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipas de Marketing e Customer Success.
  • Contribuir ativamente para o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da RealAdvisor em Portugal.


TIPO DE COLABORAÇÃO
A posição é oferecida em regime de freelancer / trabalhador independente.
Deverá já ser trabalhador independente (atividade aberta) ou estar disposto a registar-se como tal, de acordo com a legislação portuguesa.

Irá receber:

  • Um mercado claramente definido.
  • Um processo de vendas estruturado e comprovado.
  • Uma base de clientes-alvo definida.
  • Apoio contínuo de uma equipa internacional.
  • Um elevado grau de autonomia na organização do seu trabalho.
  • Oportunidades reais de evolução para responsabilidades comerciais ou de gestão.
  • A possibilidade de uma colaboração de longo prazo.

Requirements

QUEM PROCURAMOS
Procuramos um profissional de vendas empreendedor, autónomo e orientado para resultados, que queira fazer parte do lançamento da RealAdvisor em Portugal.

Idealmente, terá:

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B.
  • Experiência significativa em cold calling / prospeção telefónica.
  • Forte orientação para resultados e espírito competitivo.
  • Mentalidade empreendedora e grande capacidade de iniciativa.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autónoma.
  • Excelente organização e gestão de pipeline de vendas.
  • Experiência com um CRM como Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho ou plataforma semelhante.
  • Experiência na realização de demonstrações e apresentações comerciais online.
  • Excelentes competências de comunicação, negociação e fecho.
  • Português nativo ou nível C2, com excelentes competências de comunicação profissional.
  • À vontade na comunicação com empresários e profissionais do setor imobiliário.

Experiência prévia nas seguintes áreas é uma forte vantagem:

  • Imobiliário
  • PropTech
  • SaaS
  • Produtos ou serviços digitais

Benefits

REMUNERAÇÃO
A colaboração é 100% baseada em comissões, oferecendo um potencial de ganhos significativo para profissionais ambiciosos e orientados para resultados.

  • Comissões muito competitivas.
  • Ganhos diretamente ligados ao desempenho.
  • Forte potencial de rendimento para os melhores profissionais.
  • Oportunidade de desenvolver um novo mercado numa empresa internacional de PropTech em rápido crescimento.

Para se candidatar ou receber mais informações sobre a posição e o processo de recrutamento, envie-nos o seu CV.

Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant — Nutrition & Wellness

Position Type: Part-Time

Off Days: Wednesday and Sunday
Salary: $5–$6 per hour, depending on experience
Job Code: XT - NWC

About the Client & Role

Our client is a nutrition and wellness center that provides personalized, evidence-based nutrition counseling and wellness support. They are looking for a welcoming, detail-oriented, and healthcare-experienced Medical Virtual Assistant — Nutrition & Wellness to manage patient communication, lead follow-up, appointment scheduling, EMR onboarding, insurance verification, claims follow-up, and general administrative tasks.

This role is ideal for someone with healthcare administrative experience, strong phone communication skills, and the ability to professionally engage prospective patients and encourage them to schedule appointments. The right candidate should be organized, comfortable using EMR systems, and able to support insurance, claims follow-up, and basic payroll tracking with accuracy.

Scope of Work / Responsibilities

Patient Calls & Lead Follow-Up

  • Manage inbound patient calls, website inquiries, and leads from Facebook and Instagram advertisements.
  • Follow up with prospective patients, nurture leads, and encourage them to schedule appointments.
  • Handle inbound and outbound patient communication professionally as a virtual receptionist and customer service representative.

Patient Scheduling & EMR Onboarding

  • Schedule appointments and send confirmations and reminders to help prevent no-shows.
  • Onboard new patients into Calyx Health EMR.
  • Collect patient forms and submit insurance information.

Insurance, Billing & Claims Follow-Up Support

  • Verify insurance coverage and document insurance information accurately.
  • Track claims and follow up on outstanding or rejected insurance claims.
  • Contact insurance companies to inquire about denial reasons and claim status.
  • Gather next steps for claim resolution and coordinate updates with the appropriate team.
  • Help maintain accurate insurance, billing, and claims records.

Payroll Tracking & Administrative Support

  • Track each dietitian’s billable units to help calculate compensation using Google Sheets or a similar spreadsheet tool.

Tools You’ll Use

  • Calyx Health EMR
  • Google Sheets or similar spreadsheet tools

Requirements

Experience Requirements

  • Healthcare Administrative Experience: Required. Candidates must have previous experience in healthcare administration, medical office support, patient coordination, virtual receptionist work, or a similar healthcare support role.
  • Patient Communication & Call Handling Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable managing inbound and outbound patient calls and communicating professionally by phone.
  • Lead Follow-Up & Appointment Conversion Experience: Required. Candidates must be comfortable following up with website and marketing leads, nurturing prospective patients, and encouraging them to book appointments.
  • Patient Scheduling & Onboarding Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience with appointment scheduling, patient onboarding, reminders, and collecting patient forms or intake information.
  • Insurance Verification Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience verifying insurance coverage and handling insurance-related information accurately.
  • Claims Follow-Up / Billing Support Experience: Preferred. Candidates with experience tracking claims, following up on outstanding or rejected claims, contacting insurance companies to inquire about denial reasons, and identifying next steps for resolution are encouraged to apply.
  • EMR Experience: Required. Candidates must have experience using healthcare EMR/EHR systems. Experience with Calyx Health is strongly preferred.
  • Payroll Tracking Experience: Preferred. Candidates should be comfortable with basic payroll-related tracking, such as using Google Sheets to track billable units for providers. Advanced payroll experience is not required.
  • Dietitian, Nutrition, or Wellness Center Experience: Preferred. Experience supporting a dietitian, nutrition practice, wellness center, or similar healthcare environment is a plus.
  • HIPAA & Compliance Awareness: Required. Candidates must understand patient confidentiality and be comfortable handling sensitive healthcare information.

Communication & Core Qualifications

  • Strong phone communication and customer service skills.
  • Professional, welcoming, and patient-focused communication style.
  • Comfortable with lead nurturing and appointment conversion.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, especially for insurance, claims, and payroll records.
  • Able to multitask and prioritize patient communication, scheduling, claims follow-up, and administrative responsibilities.
  • Comfortable learning Calyx Health EMR and other required systems.

Basic Requirements

  • Must speak and write English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant work experience.
  • Must be able to provide an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available to attend video meetings with camera on when required.

Technical Requirements

  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.

Benefits

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Technical SEO
jobs.excerpt: What are we building? Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world.
jobs.description:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a team focused on becoming the best online sportsbook, casino, and social casino company in the world. We’re building a team that resonates passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight and strive to ensure we’re always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We’re taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What's the position?

The Senior Manager - Technical SEO owns the technical health, crawlability, and indexability of Hard Rock Bet's digital properties — the marketing site, the web app, and Hard Rock Digital's Sportsbook, Casino, and PMR products across the US and Canada. This is a hands-on, highly technical role: you'll be the SEO/GEO team's primary technical bridge to Engineering and Product, translating search-visibility requirements into real tickets, specifications, and QA criteria, and owning the escalation path when something breaks Google's (or an AI answer engine's) ability to see our content.

This role exists to close a real, current gap: technical SEO work today happens informally, without a clear internal owner or documented intake process. You'll build that process from the ground up while simultaneously carrying a real, active backlog.

The ideal candidate is genuinely technical — comfortable reading a HAR export, a production JavaScript bundle, or a raw server log when a crawl tool alone doesn't tell the full story — and just as comfortable explaining the business impact of a rendering issue to a non-technical stakeholder. You'll need real judgment about when a problem is a technical SEO fix versus a product/legal decision that technical SEO can only inform, not own.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Technical SEO Strategy & Site Health: Own crawlability, indexability, canonicalization, structured data, XML sitemaps, redirects, and site architecture across every Hard Rock Bet property — including a JavaScript-heavy, client-side-rendered web application, not just the WordPress-based marketing site.

  • Rendering & JavaScript SEO: Diagnose and resolve indexation issues in single-page applications. Own initiatives like verifying genuine crawler traffic at the edge/CDN layer, evaluating prerendering solutions, and validating — via tools like Google Search Console's URL Inspection — how search engines actually render app pages once technical blockers are cleared, rather than assuming a fix works.

  • Crawl Budget & Log File Analysis: Own log file analysis to understand real crawler behavior — Googlebot, Bingbot, and named AI crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and similar) — identify crawl-budget waste (e.g., unbounded, parameter-driven URL spaces), and manage robots.txt and crawl-directive changes with the correct sequencing (never disallow an already-indexed URL pattern before it's been properly deindexed).

  • International & Multi-Market Technical SEO: Own hreflang implementation and domain architecture across US and Canada properties (and future markets as they launch), including ccTLD strategy, market-specific technical requirements, and coordinating multi-domain reciprocal tagging correctly.

  • Engineering & Product Partnership: Serve as the team's primary technical point of contact for Engineering and Product. Own the intake process for technical SEO requests end to end — documentation, prioritization, escalation path — and get looped into feature and release planning early enough to catch issues before launch, not after.

  • AI/GEO Technical Readiness: Ensure page architecture and content are technically accessible to AI crawlers and answer engines. Partner with the team's content and GEO leads on what "technically ready for AI visibility" requires in practice, as this space continues to evolve.

  • Market Launch Readiness: Own the technical SEO checklist for new state and market launches, partnering with the SEO Project Manager and Vertical Directors so technical readiness is confirmed before go-live, not discovered after.

  • Monitoring, Auditing & Reporting: Run regular technical audits using tools like Screaming Frog, Google Search Console, and Ahrefs or Semrush; report on technical site health as a defined input to the team's broader KPI/measurement dashboard, with the same rigor paid channels already get.

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 5-8+ years of SEO experience with a strong, demonstrated focus on technical SEO, ideally at a large-scale, multi-market, or highly regulated digital platform.

  • Deep, hands-on understanding of crawlability, rendering, indexing, JavaScript SEO (client-side rendering, server-side rendering, and the tradeoffs between them), canonicalization, redirects, robots.txt/crawl directives, structured data, XML sitemaps, and international hreflang implementation.

  • Real experience diagnosing and fixing indexation issues on JavaScript-heavy or single-page applications — comfortable going a level deeper than a standard crawl report when the crawl report alone doesn't explain what's happening.

  • Experience with log file analysis to understand crawler behavior at scale, including distinguishing traditional search crawlers from newer AI/LLM crawlers.

  • Proven ability to work directly and effectively with Engineering and Product — translating SEO requirements into clear tickets, specs, and QA checklists, and holding your own in technical conversations about implementation tradeoffs and timelines.

  • Genuine curiosity about the emerging AI/GEO discovery landscape — how AI crawlers and answer engines access, interpret, and represent web content — rather than passing familiarity with the term.

  • Proficiency with core SEO tooling: Google Search Console, Screaming Frog (or equivalent), and Ahrefs or Semrush; comfort working alongside analytics platforms like Amplitude or Segment.

  • Excellent written communication — able to document technical findings and requirements clearly for both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and to explain why a technical fix matters in terms the business cares about.

  • Experience in iGaming, sports betting, or another highly regulated digital industry is a strong plus, given the compliance-driven technical decisions that shape this work here (e.g., jurisdiction-based content gating, state-specific regulatory requirements).

  • Detail-oriented and comfortable owning ambiguity — this role is being built in real time alongside a growing team, and the ideal candidate will help define the process, not just execute an existing one.

What’s in it for you?

We offer our employees more than just competitive compensation. Our team benefits include:

  • Competitive pay and benefits

  • Flexible vacation allowance

  • A hybrid / remote working environment

  • Startup culture backed by a secure, global brand

Roster of Uniques

We care deeply about every interaction our customers have with us, and trust and empower our staff to own and drive their experience. Our vision for our business and customers is built on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where regardless of background or beliefs you feel able to be authentic and bring all your talent into play. We want to celebrate you being you (we are an equal opportunity employer).

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.

Overview

The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API, payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50 million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.

These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment. Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or someone gets charged twice.

The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one. That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by taking scope and being right about it, fast.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and our public TTS API
  • Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break
  • Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it correct after you've moved on
  • Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that freed you up for
  • Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat
  • Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us
  • Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the product is going

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • A preference for being corrected over being right
  • Preferred: Docker and containerized deployments
  • Preferred: deploying high-availability applications on Kubernetes

Interview process

Several technical interviews plus a take-home assessment on a real codebase. We aim to finish within a week.

The assessment runs in two stages: you'll submit, get real feedback from an engineer on this team, and have time to act on it. Use the tools you use every day. You'll be asked to walk through your reasoning, so bring it.

jobs.description:
📩 To apply, email your recording the subject line "Your Name – Audio Submission"

We're working with a tech company on an exciting new AI-powered ESports project and are currently seeking native British male voice actors to join the cast.

About the Project

  • Location: Los Angeles
  • Timeline: July - August
  • Role: Sports commentator (traditional British accent — native speakers only)
  • What you'll record: Approximately 30 minutes of audio across a range of emotional intensities
  • Voice only — your appearance will not be used
  • Pay: $1,000

How to Apply

Interested candidates should first submit a demo recording using the script and instructions below. The client will review all submissions and reach out to selected applicants to proceed with the full recording session.

To submit, record yourself performing the script below and email your demo to with the subject line: "Your Name – Audio Submission"

Recording Instructions

Setup

  • Record in a quiet, echo-free room — a small carpeted space or a wardrobe full of clothes works well
  • Hold your phone or mic about a hand's width from your mouth, slightly off to the side to avoid plosive pops on "p" and "b" sounds
  • No filters, effects, or noise reduction — we want the raw recording
  • Warm your voice up for a minute before starting; the climactic moment in the script is high-energy and you don't want to strain cold

Performance Notes

  • Don't read word-for-word — skim the script twice to get the shape of it, then deliver it like you're actually commentating live. Feel free to swap words, change the name, or improvise; natural delivery beats a stiff read every time
  • First half (the build-up): calm and authoritative — set the scene conversationally, as if speaking to one person beside you
  • The goal moment: go big. Picture the stadium. Don't fake it, but don't hold back either
  • Do 2–3 takes and send your favourite — or send them all, that's fine too

The Script

"And we're deep into stoppage time here at Anfield, the score still level at one apiece... Martinez picks it up just inside his own half — turns, drives forward, past one challenge, past another, brilliant run, he's got the whole park in front of him. Into the box — the keeper comes... HE SHOOTS... GOAL! GOAL! GOAL! Oh, you have to be kidding me, what a finish, what an absolutely extraordinary finish! Ninety-fourth minute — the lads have done it. They've done it."

📩 To apply, email your recording the subject line "Your Name – Audio Submission"

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewMany believers have questions about the Christian faith that are not easily answered in Sunday school, casual conversation, or online searches.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

Many believers have questions about the Christian faith that are not easily answered in Sunday school, casual conversation, or online searches. We are seeking a contract writers to develop Christ-centered, theologically rich, and highly accessible books that helps lay readers understand challenging or frequently asked questions about God, Scripture, and the Christian life.

These books should:

  • Explain deep theological truths clearly and accurately
  • Include stories, examples, and real-life applications that help readers connect theology to everyday life
  • Anticipate the reader’s common questions and struggles, addressing them in a practical, engaging way
  • Help readers grow in faith, understanding, and love for Christ
  • See below list of suggested topics for these books

The strongest proposals will clearly define the target audience and demonstrate how the book will meet their specific questions, struggles, or curiosities about God and the gospel.

Suggested Topics

We are particularly interested in proposals that explore one specific theological topic in a fresh, accessible, and practical way. Possible topics include, but are not limited to:

  • The Holy Spirit – Who the Spirit is, how He works, gifts of the Spirit, guidance, and growth in holiness
  • The Trinity – How God is three-in-one, and how understanding the Trinity shapes worship, prayer, and community
  • Heaven, Hell, and Eternity – Resurrection, eternal perspective, and living in light of eternity
  • The Character of God – God’s love, justice, faithfulness, and how to trust Him in trials
  • Sin, Forgiveness, and Grace – Understanding sin, God’s forgiveness, and practical application of grace
  • The Bible Itself – How to read Scripture, reconcile apparent contradictions, and hear God’s voice today
  • Spiritual Warfare – Understanding the reality of spiritual conflict, how to resist temptation, and walk in victory through Christ

Writers are encouraged to propose topics not on this list, as long as the focus remains theologically rich, accessible, and practical for a lay audience.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important: Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials in asingle PDF (not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)

Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Summary of Resources and Theological Approach

Describe the key sources that will inform your interpretation and application of this biblical text, including commentaries or theological works, and explain how these sources shape your approach and serve the intended reader.

6. Potential Theological and Interpretive Issues

Provide a brief list of potential theological tensions, debated interpretive issues, or common application pitfalls that arise from this biblical text, and explain how you plan to address them faithfully and in accordance with TDGC’s ecumenical approach.

7. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

8. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

9. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

10. Front and Back Matter

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

11. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

12. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

13. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project

  • Drives email list growth in coordination with the Digital Engagement Manager through social, including link stickers, newsletter conversion pushes, and automation tools such as ManyChat where adopted.
  • Tracks performance in Sprout Social and native platform analytics against the PI strategy's benchmarks (follower retention, platform engagement rates, content mix, LinkedIn growth) and reports weekly during launch and monthly thereafter.
  • Works closely with the Digital team's social media manager and digital engagement staff to align the POGO Investigates accounts with POGO's main channels, including collaborative posts, cross-posting ,share content, and avoid duplication.

Qualifications include:

  • Excellent writing and editing skills with the ability to adapt voice by platform while staying consistent with a newsroom brand.
  • Experience with social media management and analytics tools (Sprout Social or similar) and the ability to translate performance data into content decisions.

  • Commitment to POGO's mission and values, including equity and inclusion.
  • (+) Experience at an investigative or accountability-focused outlet, or covering federal government, Congress, or public policy.
  • (+) Basic video editing and motion graphics skills, and experience directing or shooting reporter-facing video.
  • (+) Experience building or relaunching a social presence, including audience retention through a rebrand or acquisition.
  • (+) Familiarity with LinkedIn newsletters, native document posts, and audience development among policy and professional audiences.

Compensation, benefits, and other information:

This position is eligible for remote work from anywhere within the United States provided you are available during POGO's working hours of 9AM-6PM EST.

This is a full-time, non-exempt, at will position. This position is grant funded for a period of one year and continued employment is contingent upon the receipt of direct grant funds. This position includes the listed benefits:

  • Competitive nonprofit salary commensurate with experience in the range of $74K - $80K annually
  • Health, dental and vision insurance
  • 403(b) employee investment plan available, with employer contribution once eligible
  • Life insurance, short-term and long-term disability coverage
  • Paid holiday, vacation, and sick leave

To Apply: Resume required, cover letter welcomed but not required. If you'd like to share context on transferable experience or your interest in POGO's mission, we'd love to read it. No phone calls please.

jobs.excerpt: Location: RemotePosition OverviewWe are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on biblical hospitality.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote

Position Overview

We are seeking a contract writer to develop and write a Christ-centered book focused on biblical hospitality. In a culture that often equates hospitality with Instagram-perfect entertaining, expensive menus, and impeccable homes, this project will reclaim the radical, gospel-driven heart of welcoming others as Christ has welcomed us. We are open to different conceptual directions for this resource, including, but not limited to:

  • A foundational, theology-of-hospitality book that explores the biblical and historical roots of welcoming the stranger, moving the reader's paradigm from performance-based "entertaining" to heart-centered, sacrificial hospitality that reflects the heart of God.
  • A highly practical book designed to dismantle the common barriers to hosting, such as small spaces, tight budgets, busy seasons of life, introversion, or the idol of perfectionism. This book would champion "unfancy" hospitality, showing how to open one's life and home with simplicity and grace.

The ideal project will combine rich biblical theology with warm, practical encouragement—freeing readers from the anxiety of hosting performance and inspiring them to cultivate a lifestyle of welcome.

Scope of Work

  • Research, outline, and write a full-length manuscript (approximately 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team through multiple rounds of revision
  • Ensure theological alignment with The Daily Grace Co.’s doctrinal commitment

Commitment

Contract, per-project basis.

Compensation

Compensation is determined based on project scope and complexity.

Additional Information

Contractors are engaged based on the needs of specific projects and are not guaranteed ongoing or full-time work. Participation in meetings, workshops, or collaborative sessions may be requested depending on the project timeline.

Why Publish with The Daily Grace Co.?

With over a decade of publishing experience, The Daily Grace Co. creates Christ-centered resources marked by theological depth, biblical faithfulness, and practical encouragement. We value thoughtful, faithful writers and partner closely from concept development through launch. Our goal is not simply to publish books—but to serve readers with resources that meet real needs and help them treasure Christ.

Proposal Requirements


Important:Proposals that do not include all required components listed below cannot be reviewed.

AI Use:We strongly discourage the use of generative AI in book proposals, and we will not move forward with a book proposal if we detect that generative AI was used to generate or refine sample chapters.

Please submit all materials inasingle PDF(not a Word Doc or Google Doc) that includes:

1. Title and Subtitle

2. Controlling Idea (1–2 sentences)

3. One-Paragraph Summary

Provide a concise overview of the book’s purpose, scope, structure, and tone.

4. Target Audience Description (One of the Most Important Sections)Who this book is specifically for

  • Their stage or season of life
  • The particular struggles, questions, or longings they are experiencing
  • Why this book matters to them now
  • Tip: Specificity is essential. Broad descriptions such as “Christian women” or “believers” are not sufficient.

5. Comparable Titles (2–3 from the Past 5 Years)
Identify 2–3 comparable books published within the last five years and explain:

  • How your book overlaps with each one
  • How it is meaningfully distinct in approach, audience, tone, or theological emphasis

6. Author Bio

Explain what uniquely qualifies you to write this book, including:

  • Education
  • Ministry, counseling, academic, or professional experience
  • Subject-matter expertise
  • Lived experience relevant to the topic (if appropriate)
  • Previous publishing or writing experience

7. Detailed Chapter Outline

Provide a working table of contents that includes:

  • Chapter titles
  • The main idea of each chapter and how it supports the controlling idea of the book

8. Front and Back Matter (Optional)

Describe any supplemental materials (e.g., photography, illustrations, reflection questions, discussion guides, recommended resources, liturgies, appendices, etc.).

9. Timeline and Specifications

Include:

  • Current manuscript status (idea stage, in progress, complete, etc.)
  • Estimated total word count (typically 45,000–75,000 words)
  • Anticipated manuscript delivery date

10. Other Book Ideas (Optional)

If you have additional book concepts that may be a fit for The Daily Grace Co., please include a brief description of each idea (1–3 sentences per concept). While these ideas will not be considered part of the current proposal, they may be considered for future publishing opportunities.

11. Sample Material

  • The complete book introduction
  • Two fully written sample chapters representative of the final manuscript
Salary: Determined per project
